description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines staff development coordination with comprehensive infection prevention and control, ensuring the highest standards of care and staff competency. You will play a key role in educating staff, implementing best practices, and maintaining a safe environment for residents and employees.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Registered Nurse to make a significant impact. We offer a competitive hourly rate and a supportive work environment where your expertise will be valued. Join a team committed to excellence and continuous improvement in patient care.
requirements: Experience in staff development or education
Experience in infection prevention and control
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to infection control and staff education
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a highly confidential opportunity for a results-driven professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is eager to make a significant impact on census growth and community engagement. The facility is recently purchased and offers excellent compensation for the right candidate.As Marketing Director, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to enhance the facility's reputation, attract new residents, and build strong relationships with referral sources. This role requires a proactive approach, strategic thinking, and the ability to work collaboratively with the leadership team to achieve occupancy goals. Occasional weekend work will be required to support community events and outreach initiatives.If you are a 'hustler' with a passion for healthcare marketing and a desire to contribute to a growing organization, we encourage you to apply. This is an exceptional chance to join a facility committed to providing high-quality care and fostering a supportive environment.
requirements: Ability to work occasional weekends as needed
Proven track record of driving results and a proactive, 'hustler' mentality
Experience in healthcare marketing, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong understanding of market trends and referral source development
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP). This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00, providing an excellent opportunity for professionals seeking flexible work. We are looking for a dedicated individual to provide high-quality speech and language therapy services to our residents.As an SLP, you will play a vital role in assessing, diagnosing, and treating communication and swallowing disorders. This position comes with an attractive $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. If you are passionate about making a difference in patients' lives and thrive in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and valid state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA)
Experience working with adult and geriatric populations in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
